title: Blood in the Wells
summary: Mara says the cult will try to grow its god a new body in blood pits. Before you go, the librarian wants to show you what's been found in the well water. (Reward: a Sickle of Struggle. Hit creatures with it while carrying empty glass bottles and you catch their blood.)

goals.say: 'This blood was poured, not spilled. Someone is feeding the ground.'
goals.name: The Librarian

quest_book.title: Where the Blood Pits Are
quest_book.author: Old Mara
pages:
It is done. All seven.

Now the cult will try the only road left to it: if it cannot free his body, it will grow him a new one.

They pour blood into pits and throw dead flesh into it. What crawls out, they call sons.

Come. I will explain everything. - M.
